findings.proposed: remove or note: no direct UN counterpart for windshield retention (R43 covers safety glazing materials, not mounting/retention)
findings.evidence: S1. Scope. This standard establishes windshield retention requirements for motor vehicles during crashes. (R43 is the glazing-material regulation, a different subject)

findings.current: Glass, Body structure, Steering column, Wipers & washers
findings.evidence: S1. This standard specifies limits for the displacement into the windshield area of motor vehicle components during a crash. Steering column and wipers are not subject of requirements as such.

findings.proposed: add UN R22 (protective helmets and visors) as counterpart
findings.evidence: S1. Scope. This standard establishes minimum performance requirements for helmets designed for use by motorcyclists and other motor vehicle users. UN R22 is the corresponding helmet regulation.

findings.proposed: consider UN R66 (superstructure strength of large passenger vehicles) as approximate counterpart
findings.evidence: S1. This standard establishes performance requirements for school bus rollover protection. R66 is the UN rollover-strength regulation for buses.
